basis: Selected WAV SHA-256 matched to available ASR reports; only ASR mismatches plus the previously noted number 43 lexical difference.
limitations: ASR may be incorrect; this audit does not establish a real mismatch or assess prosody, stress, voice, cuts or noise. Historical report paths identify the local audition archive; expected/recognized text and source WAV hash are embedded here.
